Subject: Your breach of contract matter - Com. S. No. 1642/2025

Dear Ms. Varghese,

Thank you for meeting us on 14 September 2025 about your dispute with M/s Sai Logistics Ltd. As we understand it, the counterparty terminated the contract without notice. The matter is listed before the Jaipur Commercial Court.

Our advice is to send a notice of breach giving the cure period required by the contract. Please collect the contract, the termination letter and the board minutes and send copies to this office.

Regards,
Adv. Aditi Ranganathan
